SELECT u.f_id AS fId, u.c_status AS cStatus, u.user_id AS userId, u.mobile AS mobile, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar AS avatar, u.gender AS gender, u.openid AS openid, u.union_id AS unionId,
r.f_id AS relationId, r.market_fid AS marketFid, r.member_identity AS memberIdentity,
m.c_status AS marketCStatus, m.mark_code AS markCode, m.mark_name AS markName, m.mark_type AS markType, t.market_type_name AS marketTypeName, m.qywx_dpt_id AS weworkDptId, m.qywx_dpt_name AS weworkDptName, m.sales_company_id AS salesCompanyId, m.regional_manager_id AS regionalManagerId, m.service_manager AS serviceManager FROM member_user u LEFT JOIN member_relation r ON r.member_fid = u.f_id AND (r.f_delete_mark = 0 OR r.f_delete_mark IS NULL) LEFT JOIN market_entity_info m ON m.f_id = r.market_fid AND (m.f_delete_mark = 0 OR m.f_delete_mark IS NULL) LEFT JOIN market_types t ON t.en_code = m.mark_type AND (t.f_delete_mark = 0 OR t.f_delete_mark IS NULL) WHERE (u.f_delete_mark = 0 OR u.f_delete_mark IS NULL) AND u.user_id = #{query.userId} ORDER BY u.f_creator_time DESC, r.f_creator_time DESC
